units: <cite ref="Shabbat 116a:11">Sabb. 116ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הוה האי פ׳ בשיבבותיה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>פלנספא קבא</he>, prob. for <he>פלוספא סבא</he>; Ms. O. <he>פילאספא</he>; Var. in Tosaf. <he>פילא סבא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) there was a philosopher (a Christian judge) in his (R. G.’s) neighborhood who had the reputation of incorruptibility.
